newsitem.title: USA: Richardson starts notes exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Richardson starts notes exchange offer.

text.p: Richardson Electronics Ltd said Thursday it had started an offer to exchange its outstanding 7-1/4 percent convertible subordinated debentures due Dec 15, 2006, for a new issue of 8-1/4 percent convertible senior subordinated debentures due June 15, 2006.
Under the offer, each $1,000 of old debentures may be exchanged for $1,000 of new debentures.
The offer is for a minimum of $25 million and not more than $40 million in aggregate principal amount of the old debentures.
There are $70.825 million of old debentures outstanding, the company said.
The new debentures will be convertible into Richardson common stock at $18 per share. The conversion price for the old debentures is currently $21.14 per share, Richardson said.

Richardson said the offer should improve its liquidity and capital position by reducing sinking fund payments. It said it believes this will enable it to redeploy such funds into new or existing business areas.
The exchange offer will expire on January 31, the company said.
